site_description: Abdallah Mobaid is a software engineering student specializing in cybersecurity, web application pentesting, offensive security, and secure infrastructure research.
hero_desc: Software engineering student at City University Malaysia focused on cybersecurity, offensive security techniques, web vulnerability research, and secure infrastructure.
about_desc: Software engineering student based in Cyberjaya, Malaysia, specializing in cybersecurity, offensive security, web application pentesting, and real-world security labs.
about_focus_value: Web App Pentesting & Home Lab Security
project1_desc: Hands-on lab demonstrating SQL Injection attack and defense using Flask and SQLite. Includes both vulnerable and patched versions.
project2_desc: REST API vulnerability environment with JWT attacks, BOLA, and rate-limit bypass demos.
project3_desc: Automated recon combining Shodan, WHOIS, and DNS enumeration into a unified report.
certs_sub: Certifications & platforms I'm actively working through.
writeups_desc: Detailed analysis of vulnerabilities, CTF solutions, and deep dives into offensive security concepts.
writeup1_title: Anatomy of a SQL Injection: Attack & Defense
writeup1_desc: A deep dive into how SQL Injection works under the hood. Based on my Web Vulnerability Lab — I demonstrate how to exploit an SQLite database through a vulnerable Flask endpoint, and how to properly secure it using parameterized queries.
writeup2_desc: Exploring custom Python scripts to automate data collection and correlation from public sources. Covers architecture of a scalable OSINT pipeline using APIs and scraping techniques.
writeup3_title: Building and Breaking a REST API — Security Perspective
writeup3_desc: How to intentionally build a vulnerable API with common misconfigurations — missing authentication, no rate limiting, IDOR — then patch each one methodically.
